title: Conveyancing Assistant
description:
Conveyancing Post-Completion Assistant

Ipswich

£26,000-£32,000

Full-time Permanent

Are you looking to develop your career within residential conveyancing and specialise in post-completion matters within an established and respected law firm?

We are working with a well-respected firm who are seeking a Conveyancing Post-Completion Assistant to join their busy and successful Residential Property team. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with previous conveyancing experience who enjoys working with documentation, ensuring accuracy and helping transactions reach their final stages efficiently.

The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting the post-completion process, ensuring all necessary registrations, submissions and administrative tasks are completed accurately and within the required timescales.

The role will involve:
- Managing post-completion matters following the completion of residential property transactions
- Preparing and submitting applications to HM Land Registry
- Completing and submitting SDLT returns and arranging payment where required
- Dealing with Land Registry requisitions and resolving any issues that arise
- Ensuring registration applications are submitted accurately and within relevant deadlines
- Reviewing completion documentation and ensuring files are complete
- Liaising with clients, solicitors, lenders and HM Land Registry to progress outstanding matters
- Updating the firm's case management system and maintaining accurate records
- Ensuring compliance procedures are followed and post-completion files are closed efficiently

The ideal candidate will have:
- Previous experience within residential conveyancing, ideally in a post-completion-focused role
- A good understanding of the post-completion process, including Land Registry applications
- Experience preparing SDLT returns and dealing with Land Registry requisitions would be advantageous
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage deadlines
- Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to work
- Confident communication skills and the ability to work effectively within a team
- Experience using a legal case management system would be beneficial

What's on Offer
- Opportunity to join a respected and established law firm
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Ongoing training and career development opportunities
- The opportunity to develop specialist post-completion expertise
- Long-term progression opportunities within the legal profession

Why Apply?

This role is ideal for a Conveyancing Assistant or Post-Completion Assistant looking to build on their existing experience within a reputable Residential Property team. You'll play an important role in ensuring transactions are finalised accurately and efficiently, while developing your expertise in Land Registry applications, SDLT and post-completion procedures.

title: Conveyancing Assistant
description:
Conveyancing Assistant / Legal Secretary

Location: Ipswich
Salary: Competitive DOE + Excellent Benefits
Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

An Exciting Opportunity Within a Well-Established Law Firm

We are delighted to be representing a highly regarded and successful law firm in their search for a Conveyancing Assistant / Legal Secretary to join their growing Residential Property team.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an organised and proactive individual who is looking to develop their career within the legal sector. Whether you already have experience supporting conveyancers or have a strong administrative background within a professional services environment, our client is keen to hear from you.

Working as part of a friendly and supportive team, you will play a key role in assisting fee earners with a busy caseload of residential conveyancing matters from instruction through to completion.

The Role

As a Conveyancing Assistant / Legal Secretary, your duties will include:
- Providing comprehensive administrative support to Conveyancers and Solicitors
- Opening and closing client files in accordance with regulatory requirements
- Preparing legal documents, contracts, completion statements and correspondence
- Liaising with clients, estate agents, mortgage lenders and third parties
- Managing diaries, appointments and meeting arrangements
- Handling telephone and email enquiries professionally and efficiently
- Ordering searches and obtaining property-related documentation
- Assisting with exchange and completion processes
- Maintaining accurate case management system records
- Supporting with Land Registry applications and post-completion administration
- Ensuring all work is completed in line with firm procedures and compliance standards

About You

The successful candidate will have:
- Previous experience as a Conveyancing Assistant, Legal Secretary, Legal Administrator or similar support role
- Experience within residential conveyancing would be highly desirable
- Excellent organisational and time management skills
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
- A professional and client-focused approach
- High levels of accuracy and attention to detail
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office and case management systems
- The ability to prioritise a busy workload and work effectively within a team environment

What's On Offer?
- Competitive salary dependent on experience
- Friendly and supportive working environment
- Opportunities for training and career progression
- Generous holiday allowance
- Pension scheme
- Modern offices and excellent facilities
- The opportunity to join a respected and growing law firm

Interested?

If you are a motivated and organised individual looking to build upon your legal support experience within a reputable law firm, we would love to hear from you.

title: Conveyancing Paralegal
company: JS Legal Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Conveyancing Paralegal

Our client a leading multi office practice specialising in property, due to continued growth are now recruiting for experienced Conveyancing Paralegal to join their property department in Woodbridge . You will find a friendly and supportive culture; our client has a reputation for dealing with high-quality work and delivering a first-class service.

As a Conveyancing Paralegal you will provide support to one of more fee earners.

The Role
- Take instructions from clients
- Dealing mainly with the sale of properties that are under order to be sold
- Preparing contract pack
- Chasing enquiries and progress on the matter to ensure a speedy exchange
- Raising client enquiries with solicitors
- Carry out all electronic ID checks, OS2 and Bankruptcy searches
- Issuing contracts and dealing with any sale enquiries
- Support in exchanging contracts and completion transactions

The Candidate
- You will have at least 2 year's residential property experience gained within a reputable law firm, Knowledge of conveyancing from start to finish along with new build experience would be preferred
- Strong IT skills, experience with case management systems
- Able to work to deadlines
- Strong communication skills across all channels with developers, solicitors, lenders and clients

Benefits
- Pension
- Parking
- Monday to Friday 9am - 5pm
- 20 days annual leave, plus Bank Holidays and Christmas closure
- Discretionary bonus
- Friendly working atmosphere

Apply Now

If you feel this is the right opportunity for you, Contact Julie Sheridan at JS Legal Recruitment Ltd, quoting reference JSL2317 OR email now your cv or call for a confidential discussion .

For more information on other vacancies JS Legal recruitment Ltd are handling please visit our website.

All successful applications will be responded to within 7 working days. If you have not been contacted within this timescale your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion.

title: Floating Legal Secretary
description:
We are delighted to be working on behalf of a leading law firm in the area, who are seeking an experienced Floating Legal Secretary to join their friendly and professional team.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Legal Secretary or Paralegal who enjoys a varied role and is confident supporting different teams and fee earners.

Our client offers a challenging and rewarding working environment, with the opportunity to develop your skills and gain valuable experience within a respected legal practice.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
- Providing high-quality secretarial and administrative support to fee earners across the firm.
- Preparing, formatting and amending a variety of legal documents and correspondence.
- Organising and maintaining accurate legal files and documentation.
- Carrying out audio, digital and copy typing.
- Handling incoming and outgoing post, emails and correspondence.
- Monitoring deadlines relating to client matters and ensuring relevant fee earners are notified promptly.
- Maintaining and updating client files, both electronically and in hard copy.
- Assisting with general office administration, including photocopying, scanning, filing and document management.
- Providing flexible support across different departments and teams as required.

Skills & Experience Required:
- Previous experience working as a Legal Secretary, Legal Administrator or Paralegal
- Previous experience within a law firm or legal environment
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word and Outlook
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to prioritise and manage competing deadlines
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy
- Ability to work independently while also being a supportive team player
- A flexible and adaptable approach, with the ability to work across different departments
- Positive, proactive and professional attitude
- Ability to hit the ground running and provide effective support from day one

title: Property Paralegal
description:
Property Legal Assistant Paralegal Opportunities

Residential Property & Commercial Property Ipswich

Excellent Career Development Training Opportunities Long-Term Progression

A respected and established law firm in Ipswich is seeking ambitious individuals with experience in either Residential Property or Commercial Property to join its growing team.
With a strong reputation across Suffolk and the wider East Anglia region, the firm is known not only for delivering high-quality legal services but also for the way it develops and supports its people. This is an organisation where careers are nurtured, talent is recognised and progression is actively encouraged.

Whether you're currently working as a Legal Assistant, Secretary, Administrator, Paralegal, or already pursuing legal qualifications, this opportunity offers the chance to become part of a forward-thinking team with genuine long-term prospects.

Why Join This Firm?

The Property department is led by experienced and approachable lawyers who are passionate about mentoring the next generation of legal professionals. The firm's growth plans have created an opportunity to identify talented individuals who can contribute to the team's continued success while building rewarding careers of their own.

You'll benefit from:
- Structured support and mentoring from experienced Property Lawyers
- Clear progression opportunities within a growing legal team
- Potential pathways into Paralegal, Apprenticeship, CILEX, or Training Contract routes
- Exposure to high-quality Residential or Commercial Property matters
- A collaborative and supportive working environment
- The opportunity to develop a long-term career with a respected regional law firm

About You

Applications are welcomed from individuals who have:
- Experience within Residential Property or Commercial Property
- A legal support, Administrative, Secretarial or Paralegal background
- Strong organisational and communication skills
- Ambition to develop a long-term career within the legal sector
- A proactive and team-focused approach

The firm is particularly interested in speaking with individuals who may not be actively looking but are open to exploring what the next stage of their career could look like.

A Career, Not Just a Job

This is more than a position within an established Property team. It's an opportunity to join a firm that places genuine value on its people and invests heavily in their future success.
For those seeking a supportive environment, meaningful career development and the chance to work alongside experienced legal professionals, this could be the ideal next move.

To find out more, apply today or contact us for a confidential discussion about the firm, the team and the exciting plans ahead.
